definition_en: the brother of your father or mother, the husband of an aunt, or a friendly name for an older man
core_image: 叔叔把侄子举过头顶，孩子笑得很大声
scene: 叔叔把侄子举过头顶，孩子笑得很大声The uncle lifts his nephew over his head, and the boy laughs loudly.
sceneCN: 这里 uncle 是「叔叔」（第 01 个义项）；句意是我叔叔住在隔壁。

senses.title: The brother of your father or mother
senses.definition: The brother of your father or mother
senses.example: My uncle lives next door.
senses.why: From Latin avunculus, mother's brother, the word spread to both sides of the family.
senses.whyCN: 源自拉丁语 avunculus（母亲的兄弟），后扩到父母两边的兄弟。

senses.title: The husband of an aunt
senses.example: Her uncle married her aunt last spring.
senses.exampleCN: 她姑父去年春天娶了她姑妈。
senses.why: Marriage brings a second man into the same family rank, and the title covers him.
senses.whyCN: 婚姻把另一位男子带进同样的亲属位次，称谓便涵盖他。

senses.title: A friendly name for an older man
senses.definition: A friendly name for an older man
senses.definitionCN: 对年长男子的亲切称呼
senses.example: The children call the driver uncle.
senses.why: A family word used outside the family keeps its warm tone.
senses.whyCN: 亲属称谓用到外人身上，仍保留亲热的语气。
